name: Available Hrs
query:
SELECT
    emp.employee_name AS "Employee Name",
    emp.name AS "Employee ID",
    (SELECT value FROM tabSingles WHERE field = 'standard_working_hours' AND doctype = 'HR Settings') AS "Standard Working Hours",
    IFNULL(SUM(tlog.hours), 0) AS "Total Logged Hours",
    ((SELECT value FROM tabSingles WHERE field = 'standard_working_hours' AND doctype = 'HR Settings') - IFNULL(SUM(tlog.hours), 0)) AS "Available Hours"
FROM
    `tabEmployee` emp
LEFT JOIN
    `tabTimesheet` ts ON ts.employee = emp.name
LEFT JOIN
    `tabTimesheet Detail` tlog ON tlog.parent = ts.name
GROUP BY
    emp.name

name: Contributor Months
query:
SELECT
    ts.employee AS contributor,
    DATE(ts.start_date) AS month,
    SUM(tl.hours) AS total_hours
FROM
    `tabTimesheet` ts
JOIN
    `tabTimesheet Detail` tl ON ts.name = tl.parent
GROUP BY

ORDER BY

name: Day/Week/Month Timesheet Overview
query:
SELECT b.employee_name AS "Name:Data:180", -- Leave days this month from Attendance (submitted only) CONCAT( '
', COALESCE(ld.leave_days, 0), '
' ) AS "Leave Days (This Month):HTML:160", b.today_hours AS "Today:Float:100", b.week_hours AS "This Week:Float:100", b.month_hours AS "This Month:Float:100" FROM ( SELECT ts.employee, ts.employee_name, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(ts.start_date) = CURDATE() THEN COALESCE(tsd.hours, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS today_hours, SUM(CASE WHEN YEARWEEK(ts.start_date, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURDATE(), 1) THEN COALESCE(tsd.hours, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS week_hours, SUM(CASE WHEN YEAR(ts.start_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(ts.start_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) THEN COALESCE(tsd.hours, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS month_hours FROM `tabTimesheet Detail` tsd JOIN `tabTimesheet` ts ON tsd.parent = ts.name WHERE ts.docstatus = 1 GROUP BY ts.employee, ts.employee_name ) b LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.employee, COUNT(*) AS leave_days FROM `tabAttendance` a WHERE a.status = 'On Leave' AND a.docstatus = 1 AND a.attendance_date BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%%Y-%%m-01') AND LAST_DAY(CURDATE()) GROUP BY a.employee ) ld ON ld.employee = b.employee WHERE b.today_hours > 0 OR b.week_hours > 0 OR b.month_hours > 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN %(order_by)s = 'Today' THEN b.today_hours WHEN %(order_by)s = 'This Week' THEN b.week_hours WHEN %(order_by)s = 'This Month' THEN b.month_hours ELSE b.month_hours END DESC;

name: Deliverables Overview
query:
SELECT
    ttd.project,
    ttd.personnel,
    ttds.month,
    SUM(ttds.days_spread) AS days,
    GROUP_CONCAT(ttds.deliverables SEPARATOR ', ') AS deliverables
FROM
    `tabTask Time Distribution` ttd
JOIN
    `tabTask Time Distribution Spread` ttds ON ttds.parent = ttd.name
WHERE
    (%(project)s IS NULL OR ttd.project = %(project)s)
    AND (%(personnel)s IS NULL OR ttd.personnel = %(personnel)s)
    AND (
        %(month)s IS NULL OR LEFT(ttds.month, 3) = %(month)s
    )
    AND (
        %(year)s IS NULL OR RIGHT(ttds.month, 4) = %(year)s
    )
GROUP BY
    ttd.project, ttd.personnel, ttds.month
ORDER BY
    ttd.project, ttd.personnel, ttds.month;

name: Opero Internal Cost Report
query:
SELECT
  ts.employee_name                         AS "Personnel:Data:200",
  p.project_name                           AS "Project:Data:200",

  -- total hours worked
  SUM(tsd.hours)                           AS "Total Hours:Float:100",

  -- cost rate per hour (from Activity Cost → Activity Type → custom_project)
  ac.costing_rate                          AS "Cost Rate (Hr):Float:100",

  -- cost value = total hours × cost rate
  ROUND(SUM(tsd.hours) * ac.costing_rate, 2) AS "Cost Value:Currency:120",

  MIN(ts.start_date)                       AS "Earliest:Date:100",
  MAX(ts.end_date)                         AS "Latest:Date:100"

FROM `tabTimesheet` ts
LEFT JOIN `tabTimesheet Detail` tsd
  ON ts.name = tsd.parent

-- join to get project_name
LEFT JOIN `tabProject` p
  ON tsd.project = p.name

-- bring in cost rate for that employee & project
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    ac.employee,
    at.custom_project   AS project,
    ac.costing_rate
  FROM `tabActivity Cost` ac
  JOIN `tabActivity Type` at
    ON ac.activity_type = at.name
) ac
  ON ac.employee = ts.employee
 AND ac.project  = tsd.project

WHERE
  ts.docstatus = 1
  AND ts.start_date >= %(from_date)s
  AND ts.end_date   <= %(to_date)s
  AND tsd.project   = 'OP-INL'

GROUP BY
  ts.employee_name,
  p.project_name,
  ac.costing_rate

ORDER BY
  ts.employee_name,
  p.project_name;

name: Timesheet Summary w/Project Filter - Beta

SELECT
  ts.employee_name                         AS "Personnel:Data:200",
  tsd.project                              AS "Project:Link/Project:200",

  -- total hours worked
  SUM(tsd.hours)                           AS "Total Hours:Float:100",

  -- bill rate per hour (from Activity Cost → Activity Type → custom_project)
  ac.billing_rate                          AS "Bill Rate (Hr):Float:100",

  -- bill value = total hours × rate
  ROUND(SUM(tsd.hours) * ac.billing_rate, 2) AS "Bill Value:Currency:120",

  MIN(ts.start_date)                       AS "Earliest:Date:100",
  MAX(ts.end_date)                         AS "Latest:Date:100"

FROM `tabTimesheet` ts
LEFT JOIN `tabTimesheet Detail` tsd
  ON ts.name = tsd.parent

-- bring in billing rate for that employee & project
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    ac.employee,
    at.custom_project   AS project,
    ac.billing_rate
  FROM `tabActivity Cost` ac
  JOIN `tabActivity Type` at
    ON ac.activity_type = at.name
) ac
  ON ac.employee = ts.employee
 AND ac.project  = tsd.project

WHERE
  ts.docstatus = 1
  AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR ts.start_date >= %(from_date)s)
  AND (%(to_date)s   IS NULL OR ts.end_date   <= %(to_date)s)
  AND (%(project)s   IS NULL OR tsd.project   = %(project)s)

GROUP BY
  ts.employee_name,
  tsd.project,
  ac.billing_rate

ORDER BY
  ts.employee_name,
  tsd.project;
